root_cause: The logical mistake in the inner loop was that when character `s[i]` matched with `s2[j]`, the variable `x` was updated as `x = j`, causing the next iteration to start from the same character instead of moving to the next one. This could potentially lead to infinite loops or mismatches.
suggestion: Suggestion 1. Correct the Update of Index after Match Update the inner loop so that the variable `x` is incremented after a match is found. Specifically, change `x = j` to `x = j + 1` to ensure the next search starts from the character following the matched one.
